title: Auth oturum kontrolü hatasını kullanıcıya görünür kılma
description: Child follow-up for tsk_99541582-f790-45a7-a8b6-16dfc5ef6d37. In UstGezinmeCubugu the getUser() result currently destructures only data and silently ignores Supabase AuthResponse.error; the catch branch also silently sets logged-out state. This makes a failed session verification indistinguishable from a signed-out user even when the anon key is valid. In the assigned header and four locale files, handle both returned error and rejection explicitly: fail closed (oturumAcik=false), expose a distinct accessible localized session-verification failure message rather than claiming the configuration is missing, and clear the status only after a successful auth result/event. Preserve config-init failure behavior, successful auth and sign-out behavior, no fake client, no credentials, no weakened validation. No dependencies/secrets/schema changes; no commit. Cline read-only + Deep Plan, Chief runs commands.
acceptanceCriteria: getUser returned error and rejected-promise paths leave oturumAcik=false and show a localized accessible status distinct from missing config; successful getUser/auth event clears the message and sets the real user state; previous initialization/config-failure and sign-out behavior remain correct; four locales remain key-aligned; npm run kalite and production build pass; no secret/config/dependency changes; OpenCode leaves uncommitted.
